name: Flat fruit
summary: Flat fruit or vegetable: round, oval, pear, heart, bell and more, with stems, leaves, textures, cut halves and motion.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: shape
params.note: round = apple, oval = lemon/plum/kiwi, pear, teardrop = mango/avocado, long = eggplant/cucumber, squat = pumpkin, heart = strawberry, bell = pepper

params.name: w
params.note: width px (thickness for shape long: use about 120–180)

params.name: h
params.note: height px (default from shape)

params.name: color
params.note: skin colour

params.name: color2
params.note: second-tone blush on the shaded side, or none

params.name: texture
params.note: dots = citrus pores, ribs = pumpkin, seeds = strawberry, fuzz = kiwi/peach, peel = onion/garlic

params.name: textureColor
params.note: texture colour, or none for a shade of color

params.name: stem
params.note: calyx = tomato/eggplant green star cap, crown = pomegranate

params.name: stemColor
params.note: stem colour (calyx defaults to green)

params.name: leaves
params.note: small leaves by the stem, 0 to 3

params.name: cut
params.note: half = the cut face lies in front

params.name: fleshColor
params.note: flesh colour of the cut face

params.name: pit
params.note: on the cut face: stone = avocado, seeds, ring = kiwi, segments = citrus

params.name: shine
params.note: one soft white highlight

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, bounce = drop in, roll = roll in from the left, pop = scale in

params.name: rot
params.note: rotation in degrees about the base

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror

author: krakujs
